recipe.name: Salted Honey Butter Parker House Rolls

instructions.text: 1. In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine the milk, yeast and flour. Knead until smooth, about 8 minutes, then let rise for 1 hour.
2. To make the honey butter, melt the butter with the honey and a pinch of salt.
3. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Roll the dough out and cut into rounds. Fold each round and arrange in a buttered baking dish.
4. Lightly dust the rolls with flour, brush with the honey butter and bake for 25 minutes.
